target_customer: B2B marketing and sales teams buying predictive intent data (as 6sense)
problem: Marketing and sales teams cannot see which companies are in an active buying cycle, so they chase the wrong accounts.
product_category: Predictive analytics and account based marketing intelligence

founders.name: Viral Bajaria
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists only him and carries his 6sense bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Predicting buying stage from large scale web signals and running on Hadoop style big data stacks required machine learning engineering beyond a small team's standard work.

defensibility.rationale: Intent data and prediction models compound with data, but intent data vendors and big marketing clouds were catching up.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not stated in the sources found; 6sense remained independent and valued at $5.2B in January 2022.

market_need_then: Marketers were adopting big data and predictive scoring in 2013, and 6sense later argued sales teams lacked visibility into buyers.

branding.domain_note: grepdata.com did not resolve; 6sense.com is the later domain.

rebrands.why: Not found. A privacy tracker lists 6Sense as formerly GrepData; no source states the reason or date.

brand_strength.rationale: GrepData itself had no visible brand coverage; the later 6sense brand became well known in B2B marketing, but that is a separate name.

pivots.from: GrepData, a big data analytics platform that turns a Hadoop cluster into an analytics engine
pivots.to: 6sense, predictive account intelligence for sales and marketing
pivots.why: Not sourced; secondary profiles say 6sense was built on GrepData.

outcome_analysis: GrepData entered YC in Winter 2013 as a big data analytics tool and evolved into 6sense, which raised $125M at a $2.1B valuation in March 2021 and $200M at $5.2B in January 2022. The YC directory marks it as acquired, but no source found describes an acquisition, so it appears the original company renamed and pivoted rather than sold.
notes: Entity mapping is uncertain: the YC page text describes 6sense, and secondary profiles say co-founder Premal Shah and others folded into 6sense, so the 6sense funding history is attached here but the link rests on those profiles. Seedtable lists a $120K YC seed in March 2013 (aggregator, unverified, not recorded). Wellfound lists a $12M Series A (May 2014 per Multiples) and $20M Series B; aggregators only, unverified. Series C: Insight Partners led $40M, per the 2021 Series D coverage; date uncertain (April 2019 per CB Insights, January 2020 per Clay). grepdata.com did not resolve. No 2013 dated competitor sources found. Series E amount differs by source ($180M on Forge). YC team size 51 reflects 6sense. Exit unknown; status Acquired in the directory is unexplained.
